findings.title: Collection helpers silently discard records after the first page
findings.scenario: Tom schedules 60 assignments at his pharmacy for one week. The roster screens receive only the first 50, so Omar's assignment can disappear from his schedule even though it remains booked. The same pagination loss hides later membership records, pharmacies, shift history and Hub comments.
findings.test_needed: Return 50 roster assignments with a next page containing Omar's assignment; assert the complete roster includes his assignment.

owner_question.question: When Tom's weekly roster exceeds 50 assignments, how should Omar access all his scheduled work?
options: Load the complete weekly roster automatically
Provide explicit pagination with the full assignment count
Show only the first 50 assignments (keep today's behaviour)

findings.title: Booked pharmacist cards can show a different rate from the agreed pay
findings.scenario: Tom posts a shift with a $65 weekday rate and an $80 Saturday rate. Sara accepts the Saturday work at $80 per hour. Her confirmed and history cards on web and mobile can still say $65 per hour fixed because they use the shift's general rate rather than her agreed pay.
findings.test_needed: Give Sara an accepted Saturday assignment at $80 with the shift's fixed rate at $65; assert her booked pay label does not show $65.

owner_question.question: What should Sara's booked-shift card show when her accepted Saturday rate differs from Tom's general advertised rate?
options: Sara's agreed rate for each booked date
A prompt to view agreed pay without an advertised-rate label
Tom's general advertised rate (keep today's behaviour)
